gloss: moment of parting; time of farewell; parting

definitions.gloss: moment of parting; time of farewell; the instant of separation
definitions.explanation: The specific moment or time when people part ways or say goodbye. Often refers to the brief period just before or during separation.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}に「また{会|あ}おう」と{言|い}った。
examples.english: At the moment of parting, I said 'Let's meet again.'

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}に{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Tears came at the moment of parting.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}に{大切|たいせつ}なことを{伝|つた}え{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to tell them something important at the time of parting.

notes:
COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
{別|わか}れ (parting, from {別|わか}れる) + {際|ぎわ} (edge, moment, brink)

The suffix ～{際|ぎわ} indicates a critical moment or boundary:
・{土壇場|どたんば}/{際|ぎわ}の{際|ぎわ} - the last moment
・{瀬戸|せと}{際|ぎわ} - critical moment
・{寝|ね}{際|ぎわ} - just before sleeping

GRAMMAR:
・{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}に - at the moment of parting
・{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}の + noun - parting ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}に{言|い}う - to say at parting
・{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}の{挨拶|あいさつ} - parting greetings
・{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}の{言葉|ことば} - parting words
・{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}に{手|て}を{振|ふ}る - to wave at parting

NUANCE:
Emotionally significant moment. Often appears in:
- Romantic contexts
- Family separations
- Farewells to colleagues/friends
- Dramatic/literary contexts

SIMILAR ～{際|ぎわ} COMPOUNDS:
・{帰|かえ}り{際|ぎわ} - just as leaving
・{出|で}{際|ぎわ} - just as going out
・{寝|ね}{際|ぎわ} - just before sleeping
・{死|し}に{際|ぎわ} - on the verge of death

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{別|わか}れ{時|どき} - time of parting
・{告別|こくべつ} - farewell (formal)
・{惜別|せきべつ} - reluctant parting (literary)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Natural in both spoken and written Japanese.
